_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series WX1YZ/1, SET-1, Q.P. Code 30/1/1. 24 page images: idx 0 bilingual cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English General Instructions; English on every even index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 1-21 (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi, and every English page ends on a whole question, so nothing spills; idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, confirmed at full size. The PDF has no text layer; everything read off the images. General Instructions (i)-(x) confirm full80: 38 questions, A Q1-18 MCQ + Q19-20 A-R @1, B Q21-25 @2, C Q26-31 @3, D Q32-35 @5, E Q36-38 case studies @4. Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E: Q21, Q23, Q29, Q31, Q33, Q35, Q36, Q37, Q38, all found on the paper, and the marking-scheme walk shows exactly these nine OR blocks and no others. Main-question alternatives are printed (a)/(b). Section E prints its OR as a bare second line under the 2-mark part with no label of its own: Q36 under (III), Q37 under (II), Q38 under (c); questionNumbers carry the printed label plus 'OR' for the alternative, refs follow the corpus style (Q36iiia/Q36iiib, Q37iia/Q37iib, Q38ci/Q38cii). Q36 and Q37 label their parts with capital roman numerals (I), (II), (III); Q38 labels them (a), (b), (c). Section-A keys read off the marking scheme for 30/1/1 (ms pages 3-7) as images and each re-derived: all 20 agree; no void notes anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points are ORDINARY full stops on this paper (Q5, Q10, Q17, Q28); the scheme prints raised dots in its own working (1·8 cm, 771·4), the paper wins. Section E prints one 'Case Study' heading above Q36 and no 'Case Study - N' numbering, so no _caseStudyLabel. Q23(a) is defective as printed (see its _flag). Opener of series 30/1: plan.txt lists no reference, nothing skipped.
